verdict.rationale: Blink's docs explicitly offer a Keys section to "Create SSH key pairs for a more secure, password-less access to your servers", matching the story almost word for word. The site also states support for Ed25519, ECDSA and RSA keys, plus ssh-agent. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the key-generation workflow (e.g. options, deploying the public key to servers), and independent or hands-on corroboration that key generation works as described.
